# Copilot repository instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the canonical working agreement and `docs/plan.md` for scope.

**Current phase: setup only.** The owner plans coding for 2026-09-15, but do not
start application implementation until explicitly instructed. Draft specs and
skills are not execution approval. Do not provision Azure or download catalogs.

Follow `specs/README.md` and the repo-local `spec-first` and `superpowers-*`
skills. These are selected, project-adapted skills, not a global plugin install.

The owner explicitly requests **frequent commits and pushes**, after coherent,
validated milestones. Use feature branches and PRs after bootstrap. Retrieve
GitHub Actions logs and artifacts yourself; do not ask the owner to paste them.

Use synthetic data only. Keep identity and vault material local. Fail closed.
Country differences belong in packs, not pipeline branches. Never bundle coding
catalogs without documented rights. No real clinical or compliance claims.

Azure provisioning, RBAC changes, destructive operations, and public release
require explicit scoped approval. Never silently select the active subscription.
